# Ultralytics YOLO26-l-obb

OBB Detection · `yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024` · DX-APP C++ example

OBB Detection model, evaluated on DOTAv1.

**Input** 1024 × 1024 × 3 · **Dataset** DOTAv1 · **License** AGPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![Ultralytics YOLO26-l-obb output](../../../../python_example/oriented_object_detection/yolo26_obb/yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024/result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/oriented_object_detection/yolo26_obb/yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolo26l-obb
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024_sync   # once
./bin/yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_airport_satellite_view.png
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/oriented_object_detection/yolo26_obb/yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024/yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolo26-l-obb_1024x1024.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_airport_satellite_view.png
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 54.94 |
| Q-Lite | 54.09 (−0.85) |
| Q-Pro | 53.40 (−1.54) |

DOTAv1 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
